title: Agent Console architecture
subtitle: Deployment identifiers (emails, Coder host, container) come from the gitignored env file instead of committed literals

items.label: Share intake
items.desc: Share-to-console from phone

items.label: share-fetch CLI
items.desc: Agent download; --items 1 to 20 after (10 before)

items.label: yt-dlp
items.desc: Anonymous; videos and reels; fails on image carousels

items.label: Camofox fallback
items.desc: Logged-out page JSON carousel_media; refused connection triggers autostart then one retry

items.label: Camofox autostart
items.desc: Local URL only; single-flight spawn; waits 45 s for port; 60 s cooldown on failure

items.label: Cookie gallery-dl
items.desc: Needs instagram-cookies.txt; last resort; 429 when rate limited

items.label: Camofox REST
items.desc: Supervised by camofox-serve at boot; browser idle shutdown off (warm)

items.label: share-analyzer jail
items.desc: Reads only dirs with a .untrusted marker; share-fetch writes it inside uploads

items.label: Service worker
items.desc: Navigation preload enabled on activate; navigate fetch awaits preloadResponse, keeps the 502/503/504 retry page

items.label: App client
items.desc: Records one cold sample per page load when the first history paints; App start row in the speed panel; three-dots menu gets Map a repo (PAGE_LINKS maps-link); context panels and turn breakdown load by dynamic import; running dot pulse kept under reduced motion

items.label: Maps page
items.desc: Dashboard of map cards, overview, module drill-down and flow tabs drawn with the shared arch renderer

items.label: Render module
items.desc: highlight.js core and 13 languages load by dynamic import (ensureLanguage, highlightIdle); file viewer draws plain rows then swaps in highlighted rows

items.label: File viewer
items.desc: Modal for files linked in chat; toolbar gets a zoom group (minus, percent, plus) and routes ctrl/cmd +, -, 0 and ctrl+wheel to the zoom module

items.label: File viewer zoom
items.desc: Images: pinch, wheel, double-tap and pan. Text: --file-zoom font scale 0.7 to 2.0 saved in localStorage file-viewer-zoom

items.label: Panzoom
items.desc: Vendored, lazy-loaded on first image open; does the transform, touch pinch and bounds

items.label: Lazy chunks
items.desc: Fetched on first use instead of at cold load; dynamic imports from render.js and app.js

items.label: Web fonts
items.desc: Instanced to narrower variable axes; Newsreader 129 KB to 52 KB

items.label: Font build script
items.desc: Instances the master fonts to the woff2 files in public/fonts

items.label: Compression middleware
items.desc: Brotli or gzip for text; skips application/x-ndjson and text/event-stream

items.label: Static assets and API
items.desc: index.html, JS modules, style.css, NDJSON assignment stream

items.label: Versioned static assets
items.desc: /r/<sha12>/ serves public/ with immutable one-year cache; older sha12 from sibling release dirs; dev tree uses /r/dev/ no-cache

items.label: HTML rewrite + modulepreload
items.desc: At boot, app pages get /r/<sha12>/ asset URLs plus modulepreload for the static import graph; served from memory, no-cache + ETag

items.label: Latency store
items.desc: New kind cold with nullable ttfb_ms, dcl_ms, ws_open_ms, hello_ms columns

items.label: History snapshot fast path
items.desc: New: restore newline offsets for an exact matching file generation; otherwise scan JSONL. Existing page and reconnect cursors stay physical-line based.

items.label: Derived offset cache
items.desc: New: private, atomic snapshots with bounded validation. Page reads write snapshots; live counts do not. Cache failures fall back to logs.

items.label: History model proofs
items.desc: New development-time checks: append boundaries, conditional cache equivalence, and adjacent slices. Runtime conformance tested separately.

items.label: Maps API and queue
items.desc: /api/maps routes behind the auth gate, same-origin writes; one build at a time

items.label: Source resolver
items.desc: Local path under ~/repos or hardened shallow GitHub clone: no hooks, no symlinks, size limits

items.label: Floorplan scanner
items.desc: Vendored scan.mjs runs as a child Node process; never writes into the repo

items.label: Map assembly
items.desc: Heuristic quick map, then overview, module and flow views as PR-style architecture JSON

items.label: Naming pass
items.desc: One call on a bounded untrusted digest; output validated, quick map kept on failure

items.label: Map store
items.desc: meta, scan, architecture and map JSON; clone/ for GitHub sources; up to 30 maps

items.label: codemap CLI
items.desc: add, list, status, show, spec, refresh, rm; show prints a compact text brief for agents

items.label: console-cli tools
items.desc: New map_* tools; read-only ones allowed for issue-run tokens

items.label: Todos side sheet
items.desc: Header badge opens a per-thread checklist; add, check, remove over WebSocket

items.label: Todo WS and tool route
items.desc: todos_get, todo_add, todo_set, todo_remove messages; todo_* tool calls route to Threads.todoTool

items.label: Todo store
items.desc: Per-thread todo items persisted with the thread

items.label: Agent todo tools
items.desc: todo_add, todo_complete, todo_remove, todo_list; issue-run threads may only todo_list

items.label: History panel
items.desc: Side panel or bottom sheet with scrubber, diff, rewind confirm, undo toast, fork

items.label: Checkpoint routes
items.desc: GET checkpoints, diff, file; POST rewind, fork; WS rewound

items.label: Turn checkpoints
items.desc: Snapshot at turn start, after file tools (500 ms debounce) and turn end; rewind, fork, prune

items.label: Shadow git store
items.desc: Per-folder repo, per-thread index; skips ignored, sensitive, over 10 MB files

items.label: App token layer
items.desc: :root blocks: base, dark, coarse pointer, high contrast

items.label: Package build
items.desc: Copies the token layer, parses tokens.json; test fails on drift

items.label: Published package
items.desc: @agent-console/design-system: design-system.css, tokens.json, index.js, index.d.ts

items.label: Weekly scheduled task
items.desc: Design system suggestions, Monday 09:00, Claude Haiku

items.label: Suggestion run
items.desc: Reads Hacker News and Lobsters only; triage rule; drafts.json or run record

items.label: GitHub issues
items.desc: Dedupe by link; files only approved suggestions, label design-system

items.label: Worker prompt
items.desc: Unattended issue prompt; names the pr-evidence template and pr-evidence create

items.label: Pi worker
items.desc: Pushes the branch; stops after two guard rejections

items.label: PR evidence guard
items.desc: Blocks gh pr create; names missing sections and the template command

items.label: Review loop
items.desc: On worker turn end: finds the open PR, else resumes the worker

items.label: Draft opener
items.desc: Counts guard rejections in the transcript; at two opens a draft PR and comments the error

items.label: GitHub
items.desc: Draft PR and guard error comment

items.label: Console env file
items.desc: Gitignored real values; .env.example lists names with placeholders

items.label: Claude accounts
items.desc: Expected emails from env; unset skips mismatch check and --email

items.label: Vault alerts
items.desc: Default alert recipients from AGENT_CONSOLE_ALERT_TO/CC, else none

items.label: Caddy snippets
items.desc: Host uses {$CODER_WORKSPACE_HOST_SUFFIX} substitution

items.label: VPS console-proxy.env
items.desc: Two new lines: CODER_WORKSPACE_HOST_SUFFIX, CODER_CONTAINER

items.label: Triage Caddy worker
items.desc: Container name and validate env parsed from the two Caddy env files; errors if missing

edges.label: open or older page via Threads.page
